description: Production Turbopack gzip baselines. The ten non-ML routes and the shared host date from the React migration at 55c7024; the three ML routes were re-measured at bd925f6 against a full `next build` run immediately beforehand, because the previous ML numbers had never been checked against a build that included the ORT bootstrap extraction (5009118) or the MediaPipe hand swap. air-painting moved 13079 -> 20603 (the hand swap: two model contracts, the pipeline, the preprocess and four shaders) and mnist-classifier 6681 -> 8136 (it changed not at all; its baseline simply predated lib/ort-webgpu.ts, which all three ML routes inline). depth-estimation moved 8827 -> 8872, so that number was honest already. The check allows the larger of 2% or 5 KiB growth for an example and 5 KiB for the shared preview host. The ML routes' baselines cover the route-owned chunks only: onnxruntime-web is imported dynamically inside the example, so its runtime chunk and the ~24 MiB same-origin WASM are fetched on demand and are not attributed to a route chunk by this checker. depth-estimation ships two shaders, the model contract, preprocessing and the scheduler; its three models are same-origin public assets staged outside git and are not part of any route chunk, and its 230 KB thumbnail fixture is behind a Node-only entry so it never reaches the browser. air-painting is the largest of the four because it ships four shaders plus the pose contract, camera, preprocess, scheduler and fixture modules; its 9 MB same-origin model is a public asset and is likewise not part of any route chunk.
